title: Harassment
meaning: Unwelcome behaviour that makes you feel uncomfortable, humiliated or unsafe, including repeated unwanted comments, attention or contact.
examples_and_warning_signs: Repeated unwanted comments, jokes or nicknames
Being pressured, followed or contacted after saying stop
Feeling afraid to be in certain places or around certain people
steps: Say clearly "stop" if it feels safe, or leave.
Keep a record of dates, places and witnesses.
Ask the school to act under its complaint process.
